newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's ZCCM raises 96/97 copper output.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's ZCCM raises 96/97 copper output.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) said on Wednesday it raised copper production to 320,446 tonnes in the financial year ended March 31, 1997 compared to 307,071 tonnes in the previous year.
Copper output in the three months to end-March was 89,160 tonnes compared to 82,696 tonnes in the corresponding 1996 quarter.
Copper sales in the year under review were 326,263 tonnes compared to 289,915 tonnes.
Cobalt production for the year was 5,126 tonnes versus 3,577 tonnes. Cobalt sales for the year were 5,015 tonnes against 2,975 tonnes in the previous year.

ZCCM made an operating loss of 29,378 million kwacha compared to an operating profit of 124,703 million kwacha in the previous year. It made a net loss of 198,722 million kwacha versus a net loss of 29,981 million kwacha.
Total sales revenue for the year was 1.5 billion kwacha versus 1.59 billion kwacha.
